actions.description: Claim the failed execution Unit awaiting a response. Find its ID in jobs.get units and pass the returned lease to progress/resume.
errors: A research Job ID returns recovery_unit_required. The waiting deadline can expire or another agent may already hold the Unit lease.
actions.returns: Recovery · state, rounds, agent, deadline, hard_deadline, lease. Includes current and prior troubleshooting records for the selected execution.
actions.title: Claim recovery

actions.description: Report progress with a valid lease to refresh the idle deadline, without extending the round's hard deadline. An optional finding records a verified cause or repair check on the failed Attempt. Omit credentials, raw logs and private paths.
errors: Lease mismatch, claimant mismatch or expired recovery deadline.
actions.returns: Recovery · state, rounds, agent, deadline, hard_deadline, troubleshooting
actions.title: Report recovery progress

actions.access: Shared workspace; operation scopes, recipients and exact installation grants apply.
actions.description: Schedule recovery at the reserved queue position using a valid lease. Set preview to true to validate the lease and repair patch without running the Profile or scheduling work. Finalization-only repair preserves the successful execution Attempt.
errors: Lease mismatch, three recovery rounds exhausted or invalid patched inputs.
For finalization-only failure, retry postprocessing without a patch.
actions.returns: Recovery receipt with state=pending, rounds and agent. A preview returns current state, repair mode, failed Attempt, deadlines and candidate Profile, Runtime and storage references without consuming the lease or a recovery round.
actions.title: Rerun after repair

actions.description: Release the current queue reservation. Dependent Jobs wait while independent Jobs proceed.
errors: No valid reservation. Another user's reservation can be explicitly released; the acting user is recorded.
actions.title: Defer recovery
